items.title: The AI cost of JavaScript frameworks
items.summary: This article explores the computational costs associated with popular JavaScript frameworks and their impact on AI performance. Developers should be aware of these costs to optimize their applications and improve efficiency.

items.title: Brazilian Court Sanctions Lawyers for Prompt Injection in Court Filing
items.summary: A Brazilian court has imposed sanctions on lawyers for using prompt injection techniques in legal filings, highlighting the legal implications of AI misuse. This case sets a precedent for how AI-generated content is treated in legal contexts.

items.title: Memdoor: A team of 5 Qwen3.8-27B models beats Fable 5 on LiveCodeBench Hard
items.summary: A team of AI models has achieved a significant milestone by outperforming existing benchmarks in coding tasks. This development showcases the potential of collaborative AI systems in enhancing software development processes.

items.title: TCP Use-After-Free: CVE-2026-98432 / CVSS 9.8
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in the Linux TCP implementation has been identified, rated with a CVSS score of 9.8, indicating severe risk. Engineers and developers should prioritize patching this vulnerability to secure their systems.

items.title: HackerTube: YouTube built from videos recommended by HN
items.summary: HackerTube is a new platform that curates YouTube videos based on recommendations from Hacker News, creating a niche for tech enthusiasts. This initiative reflects the growing trend of community-driven content curation in web development.
